def download_file(url: str, path: Path) -> None:
    import urllib.request
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if path.exists():
        print(f"Skip existing: {path}")
        return
    print(f"Downloading: {url}")
    print(f"To: {path}")
    urllib.request.urlretrieve(url, path)
    print(f"Saved: {path}")
